title: Trace buffer content liveness before treating storage aliases as corruption
applies_when: Intermediate tensor views share scratch storage and a proposed repair allocates distinct buffers without tracing their producers and later consumers.
lesson: Separate Python object lifetime from the interval during which its current contents are needed. Read the planner and complete apply path; list producer, last consumer and next overwrite for each scratch buffer. A two-workspace ping-pong pipeline intentionally aliases nonadjacent intermediates while keeping each operation's live input and output distinct. In pinned vLLM Humming, reversed required_buffers alternate workspaces, and the indexed, grouped and batched apply methods sequence input processing, w13, activation/input processing and w2 before optional reduction or unpermute. An offset-zero view or multiple retained tensor objects alone does not establish corruption. Require a reachable old-content consumer after overwrite, or a stream-order violation, before designing a repair.
avoid_when: Static call order is not proof of asynchronous kernel ordering, external backend behavior, numerical correctness or race freedom. Inspect actual streams/events, returned input aliases, bypassed processing, externally supplied outputs, batched paths and supported layouts; a real later reader can invalidate reuse. Do not reject a concrete numerical witness because a comment describes intended liveness. This source-bound counterexample to an alias-only allegation is not native Humming/GPU qualification or a claim that all scratch reuse is safe.

evidence.note: The planner documents distinct neighboring workspaces, computes their maximum capacity and alternates reversed required_buffers. This supports intentional nonadjacent storage reuse, not runtime correctness.
process_input can return an already scaled input or request processing into quanted_input; activation disallows the prequantized bypass. Trace the realized result, not only a requested destination.
Complete indexed, grouped and batched consumers expose the ordered producer/use chain and externally supplied outputs. No external Humming execution or stream/numerical result is claimed.
